summary: This Hong Kong adventure moves from busy city streets to a quieter world of islands, beaches and green hills. The travelers take a boat around Sai Kung and walk its coastal trails, then head to Lantau for farm visits, fresh harvests and Tai O's waterside village. Around Plover Cove, they gather for a group selfie, share food and explore the paths and village of Lai Chi Wo. The people and their small shared moments make the scenery feel personal.
